body:
By deleting all CSG shapes except for a single CSG box (for simplicity), adding debug prints to

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f0aeea26fb9d930be42f1cdc5cb55b3acf9589bf/modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_collision_solver_3d_sat.cpp#L1501

and using GodotPhysics3D as the physics engine, we can see it returns at

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f0aeea26fb9d930be42f1cdc5cb55b3acf9589bf/modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_collision_solver_3d_sat.cpp#L1625-L1626

So the issue is caused by backface collision being turned off by default for the `ConcavePolygonShape3D` that's internally created for CSG shapes. Turning on backface collision (in the Godot source code, currently this can't be done by the user) fixes the issue, also for Jolt Physics.

Arguably intersection queries should ignore/override this property somehow, and the root CSG shape could have a property turn on backface collision (though this would "expose" the detail that the collision shape is always a triangle mesh). Also CSGShape3D could expose a method to return the physics body RID.

Dealing with the same problem, can confirm that adding `settings.mBackFaceMode = JPH::EBackFaceMode::CollideWithBackFaces;` right after the bit below in `intersect_shape` fixes it for Jolt.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/549d1846bdfc0886b4696a1a76f15206364f69b0/modules/jolt_physics/spaces/jolt_physics_direct_space_state_3d.cpp#L577-L579
Not sure what this might break later, but thank you @rburing for the heads up.
